_comment: Prioritized generation plan (see docs/ASSET_AUDIT.md). Lower priority number = generated first. 'split' cuts a sheet into N equal columns. 'reference' = existing image sent to the edit endpoint for style/subject consistency. Quality is ALWAYS config.quality (low); jobs cannot override it.
style: Stylised semi-realistic game sprite in the same painted-3D-render style as a modern mobile driving game. Bright West African daylight, clean readable silhouette, crisp edges. Isolated single subject(s) on a perfectly flat solid magenta (#FF00FF) background, no ground, no cast shadow, no scenery, no text, no watermark, no brand logos.

jobs.prompt: Three Ghanaian street hawkers walking between cars in Accra traffic, each full body, facing the viewer at a slight angle, mid-stride. Left: a young woman carrying a large round tray of pure water sachets on her head, wearing a colourful wrapper. Middle: a teenage boy holding up a stack of wrapped bread loaves, wearing a faded t-shirt and shorts. Right: a woman balancing a glass box of plantain chips on her head, wearing a bright headwrap and apron. Evenly spaced in three equal columns, same scale, feet on the same baseline.
jobs.needed_by: Go-slow jam and market stretch

jobs.prompt: Two poses of the same Ghana Police MTTD traffic officer standing at a roadside checkpoint, full body, facing the viewer: white short-sleeve uniform shirt with epaulettes, black trousers, white cap, bright reflective vest, black boots. Left: waving drivers through with a big sweeping arm gesture. Right: holding one palm up flat signalling STOP and pointing to the roadside with the other hand. Two equal columns, same scale, feet on the same baseline.
jobs.needed_by: Police checkpoint

jobs.prompt: Three separate Ghanaian roadside market stalls as game billboard sprites, front view: left a wooden table piled with tomatoes, peppers and onions under a big faded red-and-white beach umbrella with a market woman seated behind it; middle a rack of colourful second-hand clothes (obroni wawu) with a vendor; right a small yellow wooden kiosk with an 'MoMo' mobile money sign and phone credit cards hanging. Evenly spaced in three equal columns, bases on the same baseline.
jobs.needed_by: Market stretch

jobs.prompt: A young Ghanaian trotro 'mate' (bus conductor) leaning far out sideways from an open minibus side door, seen from BEHIND and slightly to the side as if from a car following the minibus. One hand grips the door frame (the minibus itself is NOT drawn), his body leans out to the right, the other arm is raised high waving a small fan of Ghana cedi notes, mouth open shouting. He wears a bright football jersey, jeans and a cap worn backwards. Full body, dynamic pose.
